title: Stop interpolating raw exception text into the sign-up failure l10n message
why: This is the exact pattern the repo's (currently broken/non-enforcing per baseline) custom_lint rule `no_e_to_string_in_ui` targets: a raw exception's .toString() is spliced into a user-facing localized string on the local/offline sign-up failure path, so the user can see a technical exception dump instead of translated, actionable copy. It is the only such site in this batch — the other three e.toString() uses in the batch are internal to _extractFirebaseCode's regex parsing and never reach the UI directly.
recommendation: Map the failure to a stable error code (mirroring the existing _mapAuthError switch) and a dedicated generic ARB message instead of interpolating e.toString().
acceptance_criteria: signUpFailed(...) or its replacement no longer receives e.toString()
Once custom_lint is repaired (tracked separately), no_e_to_string_in_ui passes clean on this file
